name: Sales Data by Product Category for WooCommerce
author: Yasar Khalifa

sections.description:
Sales Data by Product Category for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that enables you to generate sales reports based on product categories. This tool is perfect for store owners and marketers who need to analyze sales performance within specific categories.

Features

  • Generate sales reports filtered by product category
  • Export reports in CSV format for further analysis
  • User-friendly interface integrated into the WordPress dashboard
  • Compatible with custom product categories
  • Lightweight and easy to use

Use Cases

  • Identify top-performing product categories
  • Analyze sales trends within specific categories
  • Make informed decisions on inventory and marketing strategies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the woo-sales-data-by-product-category folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘WooCommerce > Sales Data by Category’ to access the reporting tool.
sections.faq:
Can I export the sales data?

Yes, you can export the sales reports in CSV format for use in spreadsheet applications.

Does this plugin support custom product categories?

Absolutely. The plugin works with all product categories, including custom ones.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce?

The plugin is tested up to WooCommerce 6.5. Ensure your WooCommerce installation is up to date for optimal compatibility.
